data.title: Contribution notice for voluntary health insurance from 1 June 2026
data.summary: Allgemeine Musterkasse set your contributions for voluntary membership from 1 June 2026 at €530.85 per month (health €412.65, care insurance €118.20). The amount is collected by direct debit on the 15th of the following month.
data.explanation: Your health insurer has set your monthly contributions for your voluntary membership starting 1 June 2026. The total is €530.85 and is collected automatically by direct debit on the 15th of the following month, so make sure your account has enough funds. If you disagree with the amount, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the insurer; the app shows until when. If you agree, no action is needed. Keep this notice for your tax return.
data.tax_note: Health and long-term care insurance contributions can be deductible as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in your tax return.
